attributes.title: 2027 Hawaii Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Hawaii Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.summary:
The Hawaii Chapter of the American College of Physicians packs its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting into a single Saturday, February 27, at the Honolulu Country Club. It suits internists who want a short local update without travel. Residents, medical students and allied health professionals can also register.

The day carries up to 6 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and up to 6 ABIM MOC medical knowledge points. ACP members pay $175 through February 1, 2027, and $195 after that. Retired members pay $100. Nonmember physicians and allied health professionals pay $235. ACP resident and student members attend free, while nonmember residents pay $175 and nonmember students $100.
